statement: Shared capacity protocol v2 is consumer-closed and verification-complete: every base constructor uses exact per-load sampling windows, positive fractional loads and unequal durations are durably discriminated, cumulative ratio arithmetic fails closed, and terminal reports remain integrity-bound.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Every offered-load coordinate has exactly one sealed warmup and measured duration, and a durable unequal-duration regression proves exact coordinate resolution.
A durable guard admits positive finite fractional offered loads and fails if admission regresses to integer-only.
Every preregistration constructor present at the successor base uses sampling.windows, including both live runner entrypoints.
Paired-ratio bootstrap rejects unsafe cumulative numerator or denominator arithmetic even when every individual pair element is valid.
Queue-delay accounting, all-error evidence finalization, partial reports, raw sample digests, and terminal eligibility remain fail closed.
